question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Previous studies of both animal models and humans, have find that involuntary muscle contractions in utero send signals to the cortex.

options.text: contractions in utero send signals to the cortex.
Previous studies of both animal models and humans,

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"find"** means to discover or perceive by chance or unexpectedly. (खोजना)

 
 
• **Example: **She managed to** find **her lost keys under the sofa.
 
 
 
• The correct word should be **"found"**, which is the past participle of "find" and is used in perfect tenses. (पाया)
 
 
• **Example: **The researchers have **found **significant evidence to support their theory.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1** (गर्भ में संकुचन कॉर्टेक्स को संकेत भेजते हैं।): This part of the sentence is correct.

 
 
• **Example:** The muscle contractions in utero send signals to the cortex for development.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: No error** (कोई गलती नहीं): This option is incorrect because there is an error in the sentence.
 
• **Option 4** (पिछले अध्ययनों के दोनों पशु मॉडल और मनुष्यों के): This part of the sentence is correct.
 
 
• **Example:** Previous studies of both animal models and humans have shown similar results.
 
 

 

39:Tb6b,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
